item.title: Bridgford Park play area to close for two days for maintenance
item.description: The play area will close for essential tree maintenance. A spokesperson for Rushcliffe Borough Council cil said: ‘Bridgford Park playground in West Bridgford will be closed for essential tree maintenance on Tuesday 3 February and Wednesday 4 February. ‘Thank you for your patience whilst these works take place.’
